notes: Feature-parity wave 2 - the console surfaces and remaining gap items from the full feature-parity audit (162-row matrix; waves 1 and 2 together close 18 of the 19 should-do items, the 19th - dual-bot reporting - still waits on a second bot token as an owner input). New console surfaces: a checkpoints card in Overview (list, detail, and a token-gated restore action that mirrors the CLI semantics, with an audit line per attempt and snapshot bytes never rendered), and a profiles management panel in Settings (list, create and remove through the persist CLI as the single source of truth; the default profile is reserved, removal refuses a profile that still holds state, and no force flag exists). New session capabilities: an opt-in auto-prune setting (session prune days, off by default, live sessions protected, one-shot advisory when the disk runs low), a sessions panel in Chat (list, substring search that labels itself as substring rather than claiming full-text, JSON/Markdown export download, prune status line), and an artifacts gallery in Stream (paginated generated-image listing that links into the existing media route). New model capabilities: a per-model reasoning effort setting (low/medium/high, empty default keeps the request byte-identical) and vision input in the console chat (image attachment scaled client-side, the multimodal block scoped to the single turn, the session storing only an image marker, and an honest unsupported note when the endpoint refuses the image - the Telegram path is untouched). Verification: new probes parity_delta1 41/41 and parity_delta2 48/48 (stable across repeated runs), core 1529 to 1596 (+67 tests covering prune boundaries, parameter pass-through and the vision note), console smoke 234/234, regression probes parity_alpha 19/19 and parity_gamma 35/35, the 17-leg real-machine E2E series green, frontend UI legs 33/50/20, settings matrix 63, activation 81, coverage 62, site gates 62 + 59, screenshots 7/7, source lint 0/67 with locale packs pinned at 662 (every new string reuses existing keys or ships an English fallback), publish gate READY(0). The parity audit document now carries a per-item confirmation section: all 19 upstream routes mapped to their console equivalents, all 10 should-surface items surfaced, and the two honest deviations recorded (session search is substring rather than FTS, and vision input is console-only for now).
